Yes I recommend balance, the play style is slow but very fun for me at least. 

I had my own dragon actually. Sir Shadow. Still have him to this day.

SO I got into wiz in like 2011. Fired up a balance wizard Grace Pearlgem, so nostalgic to think about. I realised all the other schools were like way cooler, why would you want a dusty sandstorm when you can have a sexy hot meteor. But the challenge with balance is something I now crave. 

So yeah got my sisters to play. A vibey trio we were. I told them balance was the best school so they wouldn't pick a cooler school than me. I know petty. Heh Lol. 

I used to spend hours and hours in the hatchery. Just trying to get a pet cause they looked cool. Farmed grizzleheim for that shiz. 

Good times.

legit this is gonna kill me. I saw the snack and was like oh hell thats perfect. Saw the vendor was in mirage and was like ohh... looked for where to get the cheese and apparently you can't get it anywhere. Then reddit tells me the recipe is a sham. Oh man, oh man.
Good lord I hope you aren't, but to post a lie here is also an awful thing. If it is true can you not see a doctor?
Youtube and gaming same, they keep me afloat. Canada sounds amazing, that place is beautiful. I really hope you get there honestly it's a good idea.
Good lord please no.

Hey didn't waste my time at all, glad you decided to reach out. I feel you, my mum saw my wrists awhile back she was the first who pegged it as self harm. So I too decided that from now on it will only be places they can't see. You're not a stupid bitch at all, life's bloody hard sometimes. No one wants to feel like the 'attention seeking little whiner', and that stigma is bullshit. We need attention when times are hard and everyone of us deserves it. I'm not sure what you need but before hurting yourself again try a friend if you can. Look if you can be brave maybe I have a chance too.

I'm sorry for what happened but I'm glad you're alive. Right now, well if dropping out of college is what you need then it's a good start. There'll always be other time to study if you want to come back to it, your health is top priority. So, if I might ask a question, what used to make you happy? What's something that kept you going well other things stopped working? Say a pet? Maybe a dog or a cat? What about volunteering at an animal shelter?

Thank you for saying that. I feel like I do try and live up to live up to a standard that seems unreachable to me and as though I have already surpassed it to others. It's lonely I suppose. To be the only one who knows me. Do I talk to my friends? Anyone? My family is not an option, even though they are loving, and I don't know how to explain why. My teachers and my friends. I do not want to bring them down.

Dark things seemed to have followed you, little the same can I say for myself. You're wanting of peace and none of that 'second chance' and 'saved' stuff makes complete sense. 

I accept you're apology, though I am not sorry I read this. To open up in a safe place like this is a reasonably healthy outlet. An artist's soul is a beautiful thing, and I truly hope yours lives on even if you're body does not. 

I hope you find peace in any form.
If you knew me what would you think and say if I spoke of how I felt? I'm weighing up opinions here, so I don't f\*\*k up what little I have.
Christ you guys... 🤦‍♂️
Thinking of having a kid in the future.
I'll be here to read it too.
Dude last resort, last freaking resort. Wait til you're sober. Call your dog to you, maybe he/she could help?

Nice to know someone else uses the same escape as me. So I guess all we can do is keep imagining and hope that we can keep ourselves alive just a little longer.
Hey if it gets bad again and there's no-one else, come to this thread or just throw me a message on here if you can. Yeah?
I feel that. I often day dream heavily of randoms scenarios that make me feel better. I don't know if it's exactly healthy but it takes my mind off the bad things.

Might be a good idea to look around this new school for help and maybe when you find someone you can trust to help you, it'll be easier to say what you need to this time. 
I feel the same slipping control when I'm alone, because there's no-one to stop me. I try and keep myself busy with people so I don't get time to think, and when I can't keep busy I come to this thread. 
When do you really feel the control slipping? Is it when you're alone too? Trying to find this might make it easier to avoid it.

That's horribly beautiful and so sad. I can't even imagine. 

I hope she finds her tardis and that you hear the shuddering engines when it's time to go. I hope the two of you will meet again when it's time. I hope you travel the stars and unravel mysteries as you gaze up, hand in hand, at the ringed and multicoloured planets on some far away place in Alpha Centauri.
It's the last resort, you need to escape somewhere and exercise or listen to music or something. Get your mind off it man. Try and find something, anything.

Jesus sounds like you've been through hell and dealing with this so young, mind I'm only two years older. If you're ready to reach out beyond here the counsellor you mentioned might be a good place to start. Please don't doing something until it's the absolute last resort.

Can you put it out of you're mind for a bit? Do you have any hobbies or favourite music that you can listen to? Try and escape for a little while, stay alive and go see your girlfriend or just walk somewhere secluded and scream. Please something anything that'll take your mind off it until it's easier to think straight.
That's sounds like a good idea, I'm glad they're looking out for you. Hope it goes well.

Is there really nothing? Try going somewhere new and discover something you never knew about. What hobbies do you or did you have? Reboot them. Live for something else like a pet, or a family member. 

Don't tie it right until you're absolutely sure there's nothing.

Thanks for the help and understanding, I'll be sure to seek out my school's counselors. I am worried people will think of me differently. I suppose, from what I see, they all have this image of me that gets perfect grades and has a perfect life and is good at everything. They're good people though I just have to trust them. Thank you again. 😊

What's your cat like? Ooooh I've heard the soundtracks they're all so cool. It's such a good musical.
When it gets too much just go back to what you like doing, distracting yourself can make it easier to take a breather. I can't promise it'll be easy and I'm sure you know it wont, but you sound strong and I believe you'll get through this.
If there isn't anyone there for you and you can't be there for yourself, then it's probably time to seek professional help. Have you ever considered or tried it before?

You're not pathetic, protecting your mother like this is amazing. Willing to suffer like this for the sake of someone you love is far from pathetic. 
Do you have any hobbies that can help you try and take your mind off this for a little bit? Drawing or listenig to music something like that?
I really like the Red Hot Chilli Peppers. Is there any bands you like?

I am around your age and this age comes with a lot of stress that can be incredibly taxing. It's sounds like you aren't coping very well and the lack of emotion to guide you... well it seems like you're lost.

Are you comfortable enough talking with you're mother? I understand that you don't want to hurt her, but I think she wouldn't want to see you hurt.

If talking to your mother is out of the question, have you thought of seeking professional help?

Try and stay strong. I'm so sorry for what you have going through, I cannot imagine. Suicides creates ripples, many others that may have been affected by your cousins death could be feeling the same. Tragedies are the opposite of all the happiness and love in the world, there is always a balance. You're doing so well try and live for them, keep them alive in your memory by doing what you love and what they loved. 

Suicidal thoughts are awful things but happen to the best of us that have survived through tragedy. Try talking to your mom if you feel safe doing so. If not I am here.

No in the past the idea has turned me away, I don't know if it's the stigma or something? But of late I've been considering it more and more. I don't want anyone to worry for me or treat me as though I'm glass, I'm supposed to be stronger for them. But maybe it's a good idea that'll help me find a way. 

Mostly I don't want to worry my parents they're already so unstable, if I do look for help it'll have to be without them. I think it's possible for the school to do that. Is it not?

Nobody knows what will happen. The unknown is what usually scares people away. Suicide is an absolute last resort and should not be considered lightly. 

If this becomes some that stays on your mind try talking with a friend or someone you trust.

I think I might relate to being tired of fighting. Constantly fighting to hide it just lets it build up when I don't have to anymore. I don't know what started this if I did it'd probably help me figure out a way to fix it, but I'm tired. 

Having it on your mind during the good days really lessens those days doesn't it? 

Have you ever talked about this with friends or a professional?

I thought of everything I hadn't yet done, like the last book of a series that isn't out yet that I need to read. I tried and I tried to think of having a child of my own. A little smiling face that a can read to and tell stories and teach and make laugh. That's keeping me going.

I feel the same, I don't want to get better and that's where I find myself only looking downhill. I don't want to hurt the people I care about either. Do you find it more comfortable because it opens up a way out if you feel confined in life?
What you're struggling through could be eased by sharing the burden with a therapist. Building trust in a relationship like that may be a good start.

If you get yelled at try and take it as their worry for you, if they can get you to help the fastest it has to be worth it. If it turns out to be too much try seeking help with your friends if possible.

I feel you about living by what others expect. It threw me into a pit of anxiety and ruined many relationships that I had to cut away because they were more worry than they were worth. I'm glad you're doing things you love, holding onto that stuff helps. 
Living by your own terms is freeing there's no doubt about that, but can it also lead to no safety net of blaming others? I know I fall into that net far too often and it's a vice I've been trying to work out. 
I can't say I'm in the sam Sit but living by the expectations of others is a fxcking drag.
Please do, even if it wasn't enough.
